## Summary

- **`chat-interpretation.adapter.ts`**: Add `response.ok` guard before `response.json()`. HTTP errors (4xx/5xx) were silently consumed and re-labelled as `CHAT_RESPONSE_INVALID`, hiding the real cause. Now returns `CHAT_HTTP_ERROR` with the status code in `details`, matching the pattern already used in `image-generation.adapter.ts`. New contract test exercises the 401 path.
- **`http-client.ts`**: Include HTTP status code in `postJson`'s JSON-parse failure message (`HTTP 500` instead of nothing). Makes log-diving much faster. Test expectation updated to match.
- **Mock TODO cleanup**: Remove stale `// TODO: Refactor to load from fixture scenarios per SDD conventions (requires probe run with XAI_API_KEY)` from `gallery-store-seam/mock.ts` and `prompt-compiler-seam/mock.ts`. Both mocks are already functional; the TODO was misleading noise.
- **`meechie-quote-scoring.test.ts`**: Add test asserting `selectBestMeechieQuote([])` throws `'No quotes provided'`. The throw was documented in the source but completely untested.

## Test plan

- [ ] `tests/contract/chat-interpretation.test.ts` — new test `'adapter surfaces HTTP error as CHAT_HTTP_ERROR result'` should pass
- [ ] `tests/unit/http-client.test.ts` — updated assertion on error message text should pass
- [ ] `tests/unit/meechie-quote-scoring.test.ts` — new test `'throws when given an empty quotes array'` should pass
- [ ] No other tests should regress (all changes are additive or widen error information)

Improve error surfacing for chat interpretation and HTTP JSON parsing while tightening tests and cleaning up stale comments.

- Ensure chat interpretation adapter returns a CHAT_HTTP_ERROR with HTTP status details when the upstream HTTP response is not ok.
- Include the HTTP status code in postJson JSON-parse failure errors to make failures more informative.

Enhancements:
- Remove outdated TODO comments from gallery and prompt compiler seam mocks that no longer reflect current behavior.

Tests:
- Add a contract test verifying chat interpretation surfaces HTTP errors as CHAT_HTTP_ERROR results with status details.
- Update http-client unit test to assert the JSON-parse failure error message includes the HTTP status code.
- Add a unit test confirming selectBestMeechieQuote throws when invoked with an empty quotes array.
